3526-five-weeks-in-a-balloon-or-journeys.title: Five Weeks In A Balloon Or Journeys And Discoveries In Afric
3526-five-weeks-in-a-balloon-or-journeys.creator: Jules Verne,
3526-five-weeks-in-a-balloon-or-journeys.description: A book by Jules Verne,. e wonderful “travellers’ tales” with which we have been entertained by African explorers, they can scarcely be considered extravagant; while the ingenuity and invention of the author will be sure to excite the surprise and the admiration of the reader, who will find M. VERNE as much at home in voyaging through the air as in journeying “Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Seas.”

arxiv-2110-12203.title: Large deviations for the interchange process on the interval and incompressible flows
arxiv-2110-12203.creator: Michał Kotowski, Bálint Virág
arxiv-2110-12203.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Michał Kotowski, Bálint Virág. We use the framework of permuton processes to show that large deviations of the interchange process are controlled by the Dirichlet energy. This establishes a rigorous connection between processes of permutations and one-dimensional incompressible Euler equations. While our large deviation upper bound is valid in general, the lower bound applies to processes corresponding to incompressible flows, studied in this context by Brenier. These results imply the Archimedean limit for relaxed sorting networks and allow us to asymptotically count such networks.

arxiv-2110-13091.title: Sufficient reductions in regression with mixed predictors
arxiv-2110-13091.creator: Efstathia Bura (Corresponding author) efstathia.bura@tuwien.ac.at, Liliana Forzani liliana.forzani@gmail.com, Rodrigo García Arancibia r.garcia.arancibia@gmail.com, Pamela Llop lloppamela@gmail.com, Diego Tomassi diegotomassi@gmail.com
arxiv-2110-13091.description: Abstract Most data sets comprise of measurements on continuous and categorical variables. In regression and classification Statistics literature, modeling high-dimensional mixed predictors has received limited attention. In this paper we study the general regression problem of inferring on a variable of interest based on high dimensional mixed continuous and binary predictors.

arxiv-2205-12365.title: Low-rank Optimal Transport: Approximation, Statistics and Debiasing
arxiv-2205-12365.creator: Meyer Scetbon, Marco Cuturi
arxiv-2205-12365.description: Abstract The matching principles behind optimal transport (OT) play an increasingly important role in machine learning, a trend which can be observed when OT is used to disambiguate datasets in applications (e.g. single-cell genomics) or used to improve more complex methods (e.g. balanced attention in transformers or self-supervised learning).

arxiv-2205-13757.title: Representing Polymers as Periodic Graphs with Learned Descriptors for Accurate Polymer Property Predictions
arxiv-2205-13757.creator: Evan R. Antoniuk, Peggy Li, Bhavya Kailkhura, Anna M. Hiszpanski
arxiv-2205-13757.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Evan R. Antoniuk, Peggy Li, Bhavya Kailkhura, Anna M. Hiszpanski. One of the grand challenges of utilizing machine learning for the discovery of innovative new polymers lies in the difficulty of accurately representing the complex, multi-scale structures of polymeric materials.

arxiv-2211-13303.title: On the impact of incorporating task-information in learning-based image denoising
arxiv-2211-13303.creator: Kaiyan Li, Hua Li, Mark A. Anastasio
arxiv-2211-13303.description: Abstract A variety of deep neural network (DNN)-based image denoising methods have been proposed for use with medical images. These methods are typically trained by minimizing loss functions that quantify a distance between the denoised image, or a transformed version of it, and the defined target image (e.g., a noise-free or low-noise image).

arxiv-2211-14791.title: Design and Test-Beam Results of the FoCal-H Demonstrator Prototype
arxiv-2211-14791.creator: Radoslav Simeonov on behalf of the ALICE Collaboration
arxiv-2211-14791.description: Abstract The forward calorimeter (FoCal) of ALICE, planned to be operational for LHC Run 4, will cover the pseudorapidity range 3.4 ≤ η ≤ \leq\eta\leq 5.8 allowing to probe the unexplored region of Bjorken-x down to 10 − 6 10^{-6} .

arxiv-2307-13079.title: Orthogonal-view Microscope
arxiv-2307-13079.creator: for the Biomechanics Investigations of Aquatic Organisms
arxiv-2307-13079.description: Abstract 1. Hardware in context Investigating biomechanics [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] , hydrodynamics [ 4 ] , and mechanobiology [ 5 ] of organisms is of great interest. Beyond their fundamental biological importance, these investigations could provide approaches to mitigate or address the emerging threats to biodiversity due to climate change [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2308-12695.title: Dual residence time for droplet to coalesce with liquid surface
arxiv-2308-12695.creator: Ting-Heng Hsieh 1 , Wei-Chi Li 1,2 , and Tzay-Ming Hong 1
arxiv-2308-12695.description: Abstract When droplets approach a liquid surface, they have a tendency to merge in order to minimize surface energy. However, under certain conditions, they can exhibit a phenomenon called coalescence delay, where they remain separate for tens of milliseconds. This duration is known as the residence time or the non-coalescence time.

arxiv-2410-15276.title: The pants graph of a rose
arxiv-2410-15276.creator: Donggyun Seo
arxiv-2410-15276.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Donggyun Seo. We introduce the concept of a pants decomposition for a rose, where a rose is defined as a wedge sum of finitely many circles, and construct the corresponding pants graph of a rose. A pants decomposition of a rose leads to the formation of a simplicial graph, referred to as the pants graph of a rose, consisting of all possible pants decompositions.

pmc-11453661.title: 7866 Efficacy of Zinc and Myoinositol Supplementation on Metabolic Parameters In A Pediatric Population With Obesity: a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-11453661.creator: Valentina Antoniotti, Valentina Mancioppi, Arianna Solito, Cristina Partenope, Antonella Petri, Ivana Rabbone, Lorenza Scotti, Flavia Prodam, Simonetta Bellone
pmc-11453661.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: In the last decades, pediatric obesity and cardiovascular-associated risks have been relevant challenges. The first treatment against obesity is a lifestyle change, nevertheless, no intervention seems to be effective in the evolution of the condition, especially in the long term. Thus, the interest in non-pharmaceutical as well as pharmaceutical compounds is growing.

pmc-11468995.title: The Impact of Social Support on the Relationship Between Physical Exercise and Cognitive Function in Older Adults: Sociological Perspective
pmc-11468995.creator: Yuan Li, Qun Zhai, Weihang Peng, Amaryllis Mavragani, Kirti Gandhi
pmc-11468995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). his article reveals the significant relationship between physical exercise and cognitive function in older adults, providing an important theoretical and practical reference for the research field of public health and aging. Regarding the scientific rigor of this paper in terms of the study design and data analysis, by using data from the China Longitudinal Aging Social Survey, the authors carefully explored the relationship between different exercise intensities and cognitive function through multivariate regression analysis.

pmc-11510836.title: Concatenated CNN-Based Pneumonia Detection Using a Fuzzy-Enhanced Dataset
pmc-11510836.creator: Abror Shavkatovich Buriboev, Dilnoz Muhamediyeva, Holida Primova, Djamshid Sultanov, Komil Tashev, Heung Seok Jeon
pmc-11510836.description: Pneumonia is a form of acute respiratory infection affecting the lungs. Symptoms of viral and bacterial pneumonia are similar. Rapid diagnosis of the disease is difficult, since polymerase chain reaction-based methods, which have the greatest reliability, provide results in a few hours, while ensuring high requirements for compliance with the analysis technology and professionalism of the personnel.

pmc-11517950.title: 7.A. Skills building seminar: Is Behavioural Science Relevant for Public Health? A Quintuple Helix Lens
pmc-11517950.creator: Organised by: EUPHA, WHO/Europe, Chair persons: Iveta Nagyova (EUPHA), Susan Michie (UK)
pmc-11517950.description: BackgroundOn 29 May 2023, the World Health Assembly adopted the first-ever global Behavioural Sciences for Better Health resolution (WHA76.7). This resolution requests the World Health Organization (WHO) to mainstream and support behavioural sciences in public health across the WHO and within Member States; including enhancing awareness, knowledge, and evidence and providing technical assistance, normative guidance, and capacity-building.

pmc-11657050.title: The epithelial barrier theory and its associated diseases
pmc-11657050.creator: Na Sun, Ismail Ogulur, Yasutaka Mitamura, Duygu Yazici, Yagiz Pat, Xiangting Bu, Manru Li, Xueyi Zhu, Huseyn Babayev, Sena Ardicli, Ozge Ardicli, Paolo D'Avino, Ayca Kiykim, Milena Sokolowska, Willem van de Veen, Lukas Weidmann, Deniz Akdis, Banu Goker Ozdemir, Marie Charlotte Brüggen, Luc Biederman
pmc-11657050.description: The prevalence of many chronic noncommunicable diseases has been steadily rising over the past six decades. During this time, over 350,000 new chemical substances have been introduced to the lives of humans. In recent years, the epithelial barrier theory came to light explaining the growing prevalence and exacerbations of these diseases worldwide.

pmc-11930333.title: De la salud colectiva a la medicina “personalizada”: desafíos bioéticos de la evaluación genética preimplantatoria desde la perspectiva norte-sur
pmc-11930333.creator: Natacha Salomé Lima, María Alejandra Petino Zappala, Ailin Delvitto, Miguel Adrián Romero, Nahuel Pallitto, Natacha Salomé Lima, María Alejandra Petino Zappala, Ailin Delvitto, Miguel Adrián Romero, Nahuel Pallitto
pmc-11930333.description: RESUMENEl artículo se interroga por los alcances y los límites del paradigma de la medicina de precisión y su relación con el enfoque de la salud colectiva. Para ello, se toma la evaluación genética preimplantatoria o PGT (preimplantation genetic testing) dado que constituye un ejemplo paradigmático de tecnologías que apuntan a la “individualización” de los procesos de salud.

pmc-12587268.title: Comparative evaluation of contemporary ultraviolet-C disinfection technologies: UVCeed as a benchmark for smart, portable, and effective pathogen control
pmc-12587268.creator: Mitchell K Ng, Michael A Mont
pmc-12587268.description: Surface disinfection remains a cornerstone of infection prevention across healthcare, commercial, and residential settings. While chemical disinfectants especially quaternary ammonium compounds (QACs) have long been standard, growing concerns regarding toxicity, environmental persistence, and inconsistent application have highlighted the need for safer, more reliable alternatives.

pmc-12730084.title: Optimal Dietary α-Starch Requirement and Its Effects on Growth and Metabolic Regulation in Chinese Hook Snout Carp (Opsariichthys bidens)
pmc-12730084.creator: Wenjing Cai, Xiaonian Luo, Jiao Li, Youjian Duan, Yong Wei, Yuxin Xing, Zongyun Hu, Chunyue Zhu, Manuel Gesto
pmc-12730084.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryIncorporating suitable levels of carbohydrates into fish feed can help reduce feed costs and spare protein for growth. However, the optimal carbohydrate requirement for Chinese hook snout carp (Opsariichthys bidens) has not been clarified. Both broken-line and polynomial regression analyses on WGR and SGR consistently indicated an optimal dietary α-starch level of approximately 14–17%, confirming that moderate carbohydrate intake supports optimal growth and enhanced lipolysis and β-oxidation in Opsariichthys bidens.

pmc-12749093.title: Optimization and validation of traction performance for an eight-axle heavy-haul locomotive during gradient starting
pmc-12749093.creator: Yongfeng Liu, Xueliang Wu, Pingle Ma, Xuancheng Yuan
pmc-12749093.description: To validate the traction performance of two newly developed eight-axle heavy-haul electric locomotives prior to their formal commissioning, a restart test was carried out. The test required each locomotive to individually initiate movement of a 4,700-ton freight train on a track with a 13 promille gradient.

pmc-12752369.title: Effect of a conflict management workshop with simulated mediation and mock court proceedings: a mixed-methods study
pmc-12752369.creator: Yi-Chao Zhou, Wen-Chii Tzeng, Chung-Pei Fu, Yin-Ling Hung, Yi-Chih Shiao, Daphne Yih Ng, Chih‑Chia Wang
pmc-12752369.description: BackgroundInadequate medicolegal training contributes to physician anxiety and defensive medicine practices. To address this issue, we implemented a novel pedagogical approach incorporating simulated mediation and mock court proceedings into a medical course to enhance medicolegal competency among medical students.MethodsThis study was conducted in August 2022 that recruited medical students preparing for clinical rotations.

pmc-13191239.title: Panoramic Soft Tissue Calcifications as Vascular Risk Markers in Diabetes: A Pilot Case–Control Study in Hungarians
pmc-13191239.creator: Laura Lipták, Klaudia Lipták, Péter Hermann, Noémi Katinka Rózsa, Ádám Végh, Dorottya Bányai, Béla Kolarovszki, Gyula Marada, Dániel Végh, Attila Mühl
pmc-13191239.description: IntroductionSoft tissue calcifications on dental panoramic radiographs (PR) may reflect systemic vascular disease. Given the increased cardiovascular and cerebrovascular risk in diabetes, this study compared their prevalence in patients with diabetes and baseline-comparable nondiabetic controls and explored associations in the combined sample.

pmc-13210163.title: Bedaquiline, Pretomanid, Linezolid, and Moxifloxacin: Mechanisms of Action, Drug Interactions, Adverse Effects and Use in Special Situations
pmc-13210163.creator: Marcos Abdo Arbex
pmc-13210163.description: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a critical global public health challenge, requiring therapeutic strategies that ensure high cure rates while minimizing bacillary transmission. The 2022 World Health Organization (WHO) update for drug-resistant TB treatment prioritized a novel, 6-month, all-oral regimen composed of bedaquiline, pretomanid, linezolid, and moxifloxacin (BPaLM) as the preferred treatment for rifampicin- and multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (RR-/MDR-TB).

pmc-13534667.title: Optimization of Litsea cubeba ethanol extract and its antibacterial mechanism against Staphylococcus aureus
pmc-13534667.creator: Mengyue Wei, Zihan Yu, Yunbin Zhang, Qianyu Wang, Yuan Wang, Xiaofei Zhou

pmc-13600603.title: A coupled magneto–mechanical–thermal constitutive model for transversely isotropic magnetorheological elastomers verified by experimental validation
pmc-13600603.creator: Amin Saber, Ramin Sedaghati
pmc-13600603.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Magnetorheological elastomers, as a class of smart functional materials, have attracted considerable attention in various engineering and biomedical applications. Transversely isotropic MREs containing chain-like magnetic particle structures particularly exhibit enhanced mechanical and actuation properties compared with their isotropic counterparts. Employing nonlinear continuum mechanics framework together with finite strain theory, this study develops a physics-based constitutive model to predict the coupled magneto–mechanical–thermal behavior of such materials.

pmc-13601491.title: Study protocol for FAXAge: a randomized, controlled clinical trial of fasting and exercise to slow aging in humans
pmc-13601491.creator: Emma Bundgård Fals, Emilie Caroline Springborg, Adam Bjørnholdt Berthelsen, Jonas Nyeman-Nielsen, Steen Larsen, Morten Scheibye-Knudsen
pmc-13601491.description: Biomarkers of aging, particularly DNA methylation-based clocks, have shown promise as tools to assess whether interventions may impact the rate of biological aging. Among possible interventions physical exercise has shown protective effects against many age-associated diseases, while time-restricted feeding (TRF) has shown metabolic benefits in preclinical models. The combined effect of exercise and TRF on aging biomarkers remains largely unexplored.

pmc-13661295.title: The Anomalously High Boiling Point of Water Revisited
pmc-13661295.creator: Lucas de Azevedo Santos, Siebe Lekanne Deprez, F Matthias Bickelhaupt, Célia Fonseca Guerra
pmc-13661295.description: Typically, boiling points increase with molecular weight because dispersion forces strengthen. However, H2O deviates from this trend, exhibiting a higher boiling point than its heavier group‐16 analogs. This anomaly is traditionally attributed to water’s larger dipole moment, which is thought to promote stronger electrostatic intermolecular hydrogen bonds. Yet, this textbook explanation lacks quantitative support.
